<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 121.0528. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is ≈120.045 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ (exact neutral mass 120.0423 Da) matches this value within typical high‑resolution error and explains the observed isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C4H8O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
